The actual video only shows a monochrome cube structure with no color information and no rotation — it simply appears, has cubes removed, and fades out. This mischaracterization of the base geometry invalidates all subsequent spatial reasoning and comparison with the options.

errors.evidence_quote: The goal is to identify the missing cubes that would complete the structure.

In reality, the task was to identify the shape of the cubes that were *removed* from a fully formed 3×2×3 structure. This misinterpretation of the problem’s objective led to an entirely wrong solution path.
